name: The tray
description: A short tutorial kitchen for the tray: the crate at one end, the board and pot at the other, the rack halfway along.
strategy: Lift the tray, load three onions, unload one onto the board, set the tray down, then cook and serve.

tutorial.title: Three items, one trip
intro: The tray lives on its rack. Face the rack and press {interact} to lift it; face an empty counter and press {interact} to set it down. Each takes half a second.
With the tray in hand, {pickup} loads whatever is in front of you (up to three items) or hands its top item to the station you face.
Raw, chopped, cooked or plated: anything goes on it.
You walk about a quarter slower with it and cannot dash or throw. A shove makes the load wobble; a second shove within a second drops the top item.
On a long kitchen it saves two trips out of three; on a short one it is a trap.

steps.text: Face the tray rack and press {interact} to lift the tray. It takes half a second, so you commit to it.
Carry it to the onion crate and press {pickup} three times facing the crate. The tray holds three items.
You walk slower with the tray and cannot dash or throw. Walk to the chopping board and press {pickup} facing it to unload the top onion.
Face an empty counter and press {interact} to set the tray down. Later, {pickup} facing it takes items off it again.
Chop the three onions, cook them, plate the soup and serve it.

tutorial.outro: The tray pays on long walks and costs time on short ones. Where the rack sits decides which.
